verdict.rationale: Fireflies documents registrable outbound HTTP webhooks. The uploadAudio mutation accepts a webhook URL that is notified when transcription completes [fireflies-docs-35]. A Super Admin webhook notifies a programmatic consumer of all team meetings for workflow automation [fireflies-docs-57]. Zapier integration docs reference connecting Fireflies webhooks to fetch transcripts when meetings are processed [fireflies-docs-38]. Missing for 10: a documented catalog of subscribable event types beyond meeting/transcription completion, payload schema and signature-verification docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
